camel_example: aliyun cloud-siem ListImportedLogsByProd --region cn-hangzhou --CloudCode hcloud --ProdCode qcloud_waf --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Queries the log ingestion details for a specific product
description_zh: 查看该产品下日志接入详情
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-imported-logs-by-prod --prod-code qcloud_waf --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListImportedLogsByProd

parameters.help_en:
The multicloud code. Valid values:

qcloud: Tencent Cloud.

aliyun: Alibaba Cloud.

hcloud: Huawei Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
多云的code。取值：
qcloud：腾讯云。
aliyun：阿里云。
hcloud：华为云
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: The view of all accounts within the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID that the administrator uses to switch to the perspective of a member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management hub of threat analysis is deployed. Select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
